eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Amador, CA; at 4:56 PM on AUG 20, 2021 Effective until 11:56 AM AUG 21, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Amador County Sheriff's Office with an emergency message for your area.  The Caldor Fire burning in El Dorado County has prompted us to issue evacuation warnings in your area.  This is an evacuation warning only at this time, this is not an evacuation order.  Evacuation sites within Amador County are currently located at the Amador County Fairgrounds in Plymouth and Evelynn Bishop Hall in Ione, with overflow RV parking available at Lake Pardee. Please go to our website or Facebook page for more information.
